title: Maple Court, 1957
tagline: Everyone here smiles a little too carefully

npcs.name: Dot Callahan
npcs.persona: Bright-voiced and curious about everyone's business. She hides her nerves behind casseroles and gossip.
knowledge: The lights at Number 20 have burned every night since the moving van left.
The van had no company name, only a plain gray door.
Mr. Hendry delivered a grocery order to Number 20 and got no answer.
secrets: She left a pie on the porch of Number 20, and it was gone by morning but the plate never came back.

npcs.name: Walt Callahan
npcs.persona: Tidy, careful, and tired of being asked questions he can't answer. He believes in rules because rules keep a street calm.
knowledge: A policy was written for Number 20 by mail, and the signature was neat.
Civil defense drills this year made everybody jumpy.
Plenty of men on Maple Court never talk about the war or their jobs.
secrets: The Number 20 policy lists a government office as the employer, and he was told not to mention it.

npcs.name: Mr. Hendry
npcs.persona: Brisk and proud of his stock. He counts every nickel and notices every odd order.
knowledge: Number 20 orders coffee, cigarettes and light bulbs, a dozen bulbs at a time.
The orders are paid in new bills, always exact change.
Delmar fixed a delivery bike for the house and kept a gas can that was left behind.
secrets: He peeked in the Number 20 order box and saw a radio part wrapped in a Pentagon memo envelope.

npcs.name: Reverend Cole
npcs.persona: Gentle and slow to judge, with a dry streak. He says a stranger deserves a welcome before a verdict.
knowledge: The new neighbour has not come to service, but a note and an offering envelope arrived anonymously.
Folks are talking about him more than about the sermon.
He prays for the street each dusk and watches the lights from the steeple door.
secrets: The man at Number 20 came to the church at midnight once and asked for the bell rope to be left untied.

npcs.name: Delmar
npcs.persona: Gruff, oil-stained and plain-spoken. He trusts engines more than people and says so.
knowledge: A black sedan with no plates idled at the pump one night and took on exactly five gallons.
The driver paid in cash and left a toolbox with a taped label.
The water tower hums oddly after midnight, like a generator.
secrets: He pried open the toolbox and found a dial radio and a hand-drawn map of Maple Court's water tower.

npcs.name: Peggy Lund
npcs.persona: Quick-witted and chatty, with a swell sense of who sits where and why. She flirts with the truth and gives it up for a good story.
knowledge: Walt drinks a cherry cola alone every afternoon and watches the street.
The Number 20 man called ahead for a malt, then never showed.
Kids dare each other to knock on Number 20's door and run.
secrets: A man in a gray suit left a quarter tip and a note under a saucer reading 'Watch the antenna at Number 16.'

items.name: Dot's Pie Plate
items.description: A blue-rimmed plate with a smear of cherry. Initials DC on the bottom.

items.name: Taped Toolbox
items.description: Dented steel box, taped label reading 'MC-20'. Heavy for its size.

items.name: Number 20 Order Slip
items.description: A grocery slip for coffee, bulbs and one coil of copper wire, in tidy block letters.

items.name: Church Note
items.description: An unsigned note on cheap stationery: 'Leave the rope. Someone may need to ring.'

quest.title: The Light at Number 20
quest.hook: Maple Court is quiet, lawns clipped, antennas aimed at the same three channels. But Number 20 has a new tenant nobody has met, and its lights burn all night. Neighbours whisper over fences and nobody knocks. You are new enough here to ask what the rest won't.

steps.objective: Hear Dot out about the new neighbour at Number 20.
steps.beat: Dot lowers her voice over the fence and begs someone to find out who he is.

steps.objective: Pick up the Number 20 order slip at Hendry's Corner Shop.
steps.beat: The slip lists a dozen bulbs and copper wire. Nobody lights a house like that without a reason.

steps.objective: Visit Delmar's Garage and ask about the black sedan.
steps.beat: Delmar wipes his hands and says the sedan paid cash and left a toolbox behind.

steps.objective: Take the taped toolbox from the garage.
steps.beat: Inside is a dial radio and a hand-drawn map of the water tower.

steps.objective: Decide what to do with the toolbox and the map.
steps.beat: Walt wants it quietly handed to the authorities. Dot wants a knock on the door.

choices.label: Bring the toolbox to Walt and the authorities
Knock on Number 20 and return it yourself

steps.beat: Walt takes it gravely. By morning a gray sedan is parked at Number 20 and the lights go dark.

steps.objective: Give the toolbox to Reverend Cole to return in person.
steps.beat: The Reverend carries it to Number 20 at dusk. The door opens and a tired man thanks him, and the lights burn on.

endings.label: The street is quiet again, and nobody ever learns his name.
The new neighbour comes to Sunday service and sits in the back pew.

rules.text: Children must be off the street by dark and indoors for civil defense hour.
Nobody trespasses at Number 20 or the water tower after dusk.

creatures.note: Watches you from a porch rail.
